name: Aphelion of Venus
description:
Eclipses Fire, Ice, and Plague Aspect. Applying those effects instead adds them to your atmosphere for 8 seconds.

  • Eclipse: The behavior of the eclipsed object is replaced while wearing this Aphelion.
  • Atmosphere: Enemies gain your atmosphere's effects only while within it. Its radius starts at 2 blocks and grows by 1 block every other attack.
discoveredBy: TroyTheCrafter, UnloadingLime, Schwump, and Shotdown01 on 05/28/25
